items.title: Fairfax’s Watsa Bets On IDBI Payoff As India Booms, Report Says
items.description: Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa is betting that his Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd.’s acquisition of IDBI Bank Ltd. will pay off given India’s growth prospects, the Economic Times reported.

items.description: Vietnam’s Prime Minister Le Minh Hung projected gross domestic product will expand at least 10% next year as he outlined the nation’s economic targets in a speech to parliament.

items.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Protest Leader Faces Court in Voter-List Row
items.description: The founder of India’s “Cockroach” protest movement is due to appear in court Saturday after being taken into police custody as a widening fight over the country’s voter rolls keeps New Delhi on edge.
